items.description: Build the proposed three-wave game, terminal controls, audio mapping and complete legal win replay while preserving existing games.
items.verify: Run all existing tests and require executed, nonempty Invaders engine/UI groups and a legal full-run replay. Fail missing, skipped required cases, discovery errors or failed tests; report all skips. Cover the brief boundary cases and helper output/failure contracts.

items.description: Verify the actual terminal game, freeze/recovery behavior and clean exit, preserving separate evidence.
items.verify: Real PTY checks input, fire, pause, restart, mute, supported and undersized dimensions, color/monochrome, Q/SIGINT, state/timer freezes, recovery and cleanup. Retain partial transcripts on failure at the explicit output.

items.description: Provide a documented Invaders entry point and options.
items.verify: Help works without a terminal; full suite tests flags and useful nonterminal error.

items.description: Verify the reused samples render on repeated macOS playback and mute/resume.
items.verify: Require macOS, at least two actual native playback tests and no skips; playback advancement and metered signal are not listening evidence.

argv: import os,sys,unittest; sys.platform == 'darwin' or sys.exit('Native playback requires macOS'); os.environ['NEON_TETRIS_AUDIO_TESTS']='1'; suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests', pattern='test_native_audio.py'); suite.countTestCases() >= 2 or sys.exit('Missing native tests'); result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite); sys.exit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and result.testsRun >= 2 and not result.skipped else 1)

items.description: Inspect the real presentation and record honest play and sound observations.
items.verify: Retain and actually view color/monochrome captures at 80x30 and 100x35 across ready/play/pause/win/loss; document method, readability and style findings. Record actual listening and Jon play feedback, or explicitly pending. Pending feedback does not establish fair difficulty or enjoyable play.

items.description: Document use and carry actual Substrate observations into the final retrospective.
items.verify: README/design notes match the game. Fresh build/review sessions identify scope, actual authority, evidence and next steps from saved files. Handoff records mistakes, manual interventions, repeated context, limitations and remaining work; final retrospective distinguishes observed process results from proposals. No claim of completed delivery before current verification/review and a reviewable PR.
